entities.name: Turcius Rufius Apronianus Asterius
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Turcius Rufius Apronianus Asterius was a Roman aristocrat during the reign of Theodoric the Great. He held the consulship with Flavius Praesidius in 494, having been praefectus urbi of Rome before holding that honor.
